revision_reason: v1 표본에서는 fault1/2 양성이 0건이어서 주 지표를 정의할 수 없었다.
최종 비교 대상을 04b로 명시하고 structural rescue lane 설계를 채택한다.
07a에서는 JEV/LLM 성과를 ground-truth label로 평가한 적이 없다.

sampling.population: fault1/fault2/fault3 test original sequences only, from split_metadata.json.
sampling.endpoint_source: 04b fault-specific test prediction parquet; no label columns loaded before ranking freeze.
sampling.duplicate_index: Coalesce identical row positions and record all percentiles mapped to each row.

tier.04b_rule: Saved Huang rule: RF probability >= 0.5; gated LSTM output must agree.
tier.tier1: LSTM alarm AND 04b pass; immediate review.
tier.rescue: LSTM alarm AND 04b reject; structural rescue population.

JEV_R2.definition: 07a R1 with only the RF probability sentence and RF references in criteria removed.

question.instructions: Using only state.features, evaluate the evidence associated with this existing LSTM alarm for a fault within 5000 seconds. Do not estimate a new time to failure. Weigh supporting and contradicting evidence in a balanced way. The alarm is never cancelled by this score; the score only describes how deeply the case should be analyzed. lstm_pred_seconds: smaller values indicate a more imminent fault. recent_lstm_delta: current minus the oldest of the last five causal LSTM predictions; negative means the predicted failure time is falling. recent_lstm_std: population variability across those five predictions. ROTATIONSPEED, IONGAUGEPRESSURE, ETCHSUPPRESSORCURRENT, FLOWCOOLPRESSURE, ETCHBEAMCURRENT, and FLOWCOOLFLOWRATE are current normalized model-input sensor readings; their physical units are unverified. ROTATIONSPEED__rms is RMS magnitude over the current and preceding 99 readings. IONGAUGEPRESSURE__shape_factor and FLOWCOOLPRESSURE__shape_factor are RMS divided by mean absolute magnitude over those 100 readings. ETCHSUPPRESSORCURRENT__peak_abs, FLOWCOOLPRESSURE__peak_abs, and FLOWCOOLFLOWRATE__peak_abs are peak absolute magnitude over those 100 readings. fault_type identifies the fault family (1, 2, or 3); it is not evidence of when the fault will occur. Choose Weak, Uncertain, or Strong from the combined evidence. Do not infer sequence identity, timestamp, or actual failure time.
criteria: Weak: the LSTM trend, and sensor evidence give weak support for urgent analysis; the alarm remains in the review queue
Uncertain: the LSTM trend, and sensor evidence are mixed or insufficient; the alarm remains in the review queue
Strong: the LSTM trend, and sensor evidence give strong support for deeper analysis; the alarm remains in the review queue

LLM_packet.definition: 07a packet v1 with RF field removed; packet_version 07a-evidence-v1-noRF.
LLM_packet.population: Call every rescue row once; reuse the output in every routing comparison.

stability.selection: 07a seeded random choice after sorting sequence_group,row_id; numpy default_rng(20260927), without replacement.

JEV.population: Within each fault's valid-score rescue rows.
JEV.rounding: round-half-up; score descending then internal row key ascending.
JEV.MID_order: LLM priority_score descending; tie JEV score descending then row key.
JEV.LOW_order: JEV score descending; unavailable JEV last.
JEV.unavailable: LOW after valid LOW; MID is half-up 50% of valid JEV scores.
JEV.MID_uses: The single existing full-rescue LLM output; no route-specific calls.

routing.full_LLM: priority_score descending; MODEL_UNAVAILABLE last; no imputation; row-key tie.

random.LLM_budget: Exact integer JEV MID count per fault.
random.remaining: Random HIGH/LOW allocation in half-up equal counts; random order.
random.MID_order: LLM priority_score descending; randomized tie order.

LSTM.rounding: round-half-up; score descending then row key.

no_LLM_baselines.Logistic: 07a v1-noRF numeric fields; READY train+validation only; StandardScaler; LogisticRegression(C=1,solver=lbfgs,max_iter=5000).

routing.same_LLM_failure: Reuse the same full-rescue output/unavailable status in every routing comparison.

review_budgets.combined: Pool each fault-specific top-E reviewed rows and positives.

primary_population: fault1+fault2 combined rescue; fault3 separately reported.

feasibility.failure: INSUFFICIENT_CONFIRMATORY_SAMPLE; no H1-H3 formal conclusion, descriptive/exploratory continue.

bootstrap.unit: Sequence resampling with replacement within fault; keep all rescue rows.
bootstrap.H3_randomization: Point comparator is mean of 1,000 seeded budget-matched routes; each sequence-bootstrap replicate uses exact conditional expected precision under the same randomized HIGH/MID/LOW assignment, preserving the frozen LLM order within MID.
bootstrap.E: Recompute half-up E20 per fault for each bootstrap sample and use frozen rank.

hypotheses.H1: JEV precision@E20 minus rescue positive prevalence; lower bound > 0.
hypotheses.H2: JEV precision@E20 minus full LLM precision@E20; margin -0.05; lower bound > -0.05.
hypotheses.H3: JEV precision@E20 minus mean of 1,000 random-routing precision@E20; lower bound > 0.
hypotheses.gatekeeping: Test H2 only after H1 passes; test H3 only after H1 and H2 pass.

effect_vs_04b.rescue_recovery: top-E rescue positives / all sampled rescue positives.
effect_vs_04b.structural_recall: (tier1 positives + top-E rescue positives) / all sampled positives.

cost_curve.break_even: additional review rows / additional recovered positives when positive count is nonzero.

call_budget.cost_source: 07a cost_estimate_07b: observed JEV mean call cost; LLM smoke mean cost.
call_budget.rule: Stop before next request if known actual cumulative cost plus preregistered unit estimate exceeds cap.

failure_handling.first_schema_failure: JEV: STOP_FIRST_JEV_SCHEMA_FAILURE; LLM: retry twice, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE on exhaustion.
failure_handling.LLM_unavailable_ranking: Sort last; use same status for all routing comparisons.
failure_handling.first20_LLM: Stop if >=3 invalid after retries among first 20 main rows.
failure_handling.LLM_unavailable_rate: More than 5% main rescue rows unavailable: descriptive only.

test_history_note: fault3 test was examined in 06 series and is not completely unseen.
amendment_reason:
첫 LLM 응답 1건이 JSON 뒤 추가 텍스트로 파싱에 실패해 STOP_FIRST_LLM_SCHEMA_FAILURE로 중단됨.
라벨 미개봉, 순위 미확정 상태에서 실행 규칙만 개정함. 가설, 지표, 표본, 정렬 규칙은 변경 없음.

amendment.schema_retry: Same request body, at most 2 additional attempts for LLM parsing/schema failure; complete json.loads only; never partial JSON.
amendment.first20: First 20 rescue rows sorted by row_key, including same-request successful caches; stop if at least 3 invalid after retries.
amendment.unavailable_rate: Main rescue LLM unavailable rows / all rescue rows > 0.05: descriptive statistics only, no formal hypothesis testing.
amendment.diagnostics: Save failed raw text under failed_raw with secrets redacted. Print one actual request body with strict json_schema.
amendment.cache: Reuse only exact canonical request SHA-256 match; same settings as v2.
amendment.stability_implementation: Restrict calls to the five already preregistered STABILITY_KEYS, 3 repeats each.
amendment.sensitivity: Exclude main LLM MODEL_UNAVAILABLE rows from every frozen ranking, preserve relative order, recompute per-fault E20 and H1-H3 with same sequence bootstrap and gatekeeping; sensitivity only, primary decisions unchanged.
amendment.historical_failed_raw: Original v2 client did not persist the failed raw response; it cannot be recovered. New failures are persisted.
